subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be considered solved by a dedicated skills lint command, or must normal skills list/check/status/Web surfaces also show skipped-candidate failures?
rationale: Current main lacks both paths, and the open PR implements lint-oriented diagnostics while this issue asks for broader always-visible behavior.

options.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
options.body: Treat this issue as complete only when list/check/status/Web can expose skipped skill candidates in addition to any lint command.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Let the open PR close the core issue after fixing its review blocker, and track normal-surface visibility as a follow-up.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Hold the PR and define a shared diagnostic model before adding public CLI/status fields.

recommendation.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as complete only when list/check/status/Web can expose skipped skill candidates in addition to any lint command.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the most direct work across the skill loading, status, and CLI surfaces that need the scope decision.
